description: Image-only input quality gates for palmistry, face reading, and handwriting photos: detect failures, retake vs lower-confidence, warm phrasing, privacy.
commercial_flags: Biometric/face data is sensitive PII — disclose retention, purpose limitation, and deletion in privacy policy.
Never claim medical diagnosis from face/palm photos.
Palm/face/handwriting readings from photos are entertainment/symbolic unless a licensed professional reviews.

minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.fate_line: Optional; often faint — do not fail solely on missing fate line
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.resolution: Prefer native phone resolution; avoid heavy compression/beauty filters that erase creases
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.focus: Sharp across full palm (not only fingertips)
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.lighting: Even, diffuse daylight or soft lamp; no direct flash washout; no hard shadows mistaken for breaks
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.framing: Wrist crease through all fingertips; palm fills most of frame; camera parallel/overhead ~forearm length
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.pose: Palm flat/open, fingers slightly spread, no sharp bend toward lens; one hand only
minimum_quality_to_read_major_lines.obstructions: Remove rings/bracelets covering joints/lines; clean ink/dirt; no overlapping second hand

failure_detectors.detect: Laplacian/variance or text/crease sharpness below threshold across palm center
Missing wrist, fingertips, or >20% palm cropped
Strong foreshortening / camera not roughly parallel to palm plane
Jewelry, ink, bandage, or finger overlap occluding major crease regions
Specular highlights or deep shadows over line regions
More than one hand in frame

retake_guidance: Spread fingers slightly; rest palm flat on a non-reflective contrasting surface.
Shoot straight overhead (camera parallel to palm), not from an angle.
Use even daylight; turn beauty filters and flash off; tap to focus on palm center.
Include wrist crease to fingertips; remove jewelry that covers lines.
Hold still for a second so creases stay sharp.
palmistry_photos.both_hands_note: Prefer left and right; tradition often contrasts non-dominant (disposition) vs dominant (developed). Optional side view for finger proportions.

requirements.pose: Front-facing, head level, eyes to camera, neutral expression, lips relaxed
requirements.framing: Face centered; forehead to chin visible; ears preferably visible; face ~70–80% of crop when possible
requirements.distance: Prefer rear camera ~1–2 m with 2–3× zoom to reduce wide-angle distortion; avoid extreme close selfie distortion
requirements.lighting: Even soft light (face a window); no harsh side/overhead shadows; no blown highlights
requirements.expression: Neutral preferred; mild smile ok; avoid exaggerated expressions

interference.effect: Frames/reflections hide canthi and brow landmarks
interference.policy: Ask to remove if safe/comfortable; if kept: no tint, no flash reflection, frames not covering eyes — lower confidence
Allow with lower confidence on jaw-related cues; do not demand shaving

interference.effect: Can alter perceived proportions and skin texture
interference.policy: Warn that reading is of presented appearance; lower confidence on texture cues
Retake — ask to clear face (religious head covering exception: keep covering but show chin-to-forehead features as feasible)

failure_detectors.detect: Eyes, nose, or mouth missing from crop
Mask, hand, heavy bangs over eyes

legibility_thresholds.accept_auto: Quality grade excellent or good (sharp characters across sampled text boxes)
legibility_thresholds.accept_low_confidence: Grade reasonable — proceed with explicit lower-confidence banner
legibility_thresholds.reject_retake: Grade poor or very poor; or critical fields unreadable

cursive_vs_print.print: Generally higher OCR confidence; prefer for name/number extraction
cursive_vs_print.cursive: Allow but raise uncertainty; if agreement across readers is low, ask for print rewrite or typed confirm
cursive_vs_print.mixed: Score per region; retake only regions that fail

paper_background_issues: Lined/graph paper bleed into glyphs — warn or enhance carefully
Patterned/dark paper low contrast — retake on plain light paper
Glare from glossy paper or plastic sleeve — retake without sleeve
Shadows across page — retake with even light
Cropped margins / missing corners — retake with full page in frame
Upside-down / rotated — auto-orient via EXIF then content; confirm with user if uncertain

blur_detection.approach: Compute sharpness (e.g. Laplacian variance) on ROI (palm center / face box / text boxes). Combine with exposure and glare checks.

suggested_bands.pass: sharpness >= high_threshold AND exposure in mid range AND glare_ratio < low
suggested_bands.soft_warn: between thresholds — offer continue with lower confidence

blur_detection.note: Absolute numeric thresholds are device/model-specific; calibrate on your model. Do not hardcode a universal Laplacian number without validation.

allow_lower_confidence: fate line invisible but other lines clear
retake_vs_lower_confidence.retry_cap: After 3 rejections, accept last image with strong low-confidence banner so users are never permanently blocked (document-capture UX pattern).

principles: Blame the photo conditions, never the person.
Encourage: this is entertainment setup, not a test you can fail.
templates: Almost there — the palm is a bit soft/blurry. Hold still and tap the center of your palm to focus, then try one more shot.
We can't see the whole hand yet. Scoot back a little so your wrist and fingertips are both in frame.
The angle is squashing the lines. Hover the camera straight above your palm like a bird's-eye view.
There's a bright glare on the lines. Turn off the flash and face a window for soft light.
Filters can smooth away the creases we read. Switch to the plain camera (no beauty mode) and shoot again.
For face reading, look straight at the lens with a relaxed face — a slight smile is fine; tilt makes the ratios harder to read.
If you're comfortable removing glasses for this photo, the eye area reads more clearly. If not, we'll continue with a gentler confidence note.
The writing is a little hard to make out. A closer, sharper photo on plain paper (or printing the same words) helps a lot.

principles: Collect only for the stated reading purpose.
Encrypt in transit and at rest.
Default short retention: delete raw images after analysis completes unless user opts into save/history.
No secondary use (ads, training sale) without explicit opt-in consent.
Provide in-app delete and export of stored images.
Face/palm biometrics are sensitive — disclose in privacy policy and regional compliance (e.g. GDPR special category where applicable).
On-device preprocessing preferred when feasible; minimize server retention.
Never display another user's images; isolate by account.
privacy.user_copy_example: Your photo is used only to generate this reading. We delete the image after analysis unless you save it to your history. You can delete saved photos anytime.
